name: Weighing and correcting
definition: Weighing alternatives or correcting itself: but, wait, no, should; questioning whether something is right.

name: Notes: selecting and dragging
definition: Reasoning about how notes are selected, edited, clicked and dragged: pointer events and selection state.

name: Fixing a test
definition: Deciding to fix or rewrite a test, or saying what is wrong with it.

name: Module code
definition: TypeScript module code: imports, exports and type declarations.

name: Announcing a write
definition: Announcing the next file or component to write: now let me write or create something.

name: Code drafted in thought
definition: Code drafted inside the thinking: functions, constants, returns.

name: Looking at code
definition: Reading existing code to understand it: let me look at something.

name: Running tests
definition: Running the tests, build or typecheck, and noting that they pass.

name: Tracking test cases
definition: Tracking test cases by number (TC-nn): which pass, fail or remain.

name: Shared document and sync
definition: Reasoning about the shared document, its updates and the sync messages.

name: Size arithmetic
definition: Arithmetic over widths, heights, sizes and boxes, often with check marks.

name: Checking a detail
definition: Checking a detail, a version or what something does: let me check something.

name: Zoom and camera maths
definition: Zoom and camera coordinate arithmetic: screen and world positions.

name: End-to-end test code
definition: Playwright end-to-end test code: page, await, expect.

name: None of these
definition: Fits none of the themes above.
